purpose: Make Admiral standing materially useful without quota-filling Relationship with duplicate items: standing may increase finite replenishment of an already-admitted consumable mission-preparation offer, while non-consumable Baseline equipment remains unchanged.

required: offer already belongs to frozen Baseline rather than Milestone capability stock
item is consumed by ordinary field preparation so additional personal replenishment has recurring utility
uplift remains finite at every standing tier
uplift does not create a new item source, quest bypass or ammunition/access capability
excluded: extract utility items that are normally retained rather than consumed

reviewedBaselineOffers.reason: The compass is durable navigation equipment. Standing should not manufacture repeated renewable copies of a tool the player normally needs only once.

Paracord already has bounded Baseline availability and is normally retained for extraction utility; increasing replenishment would primarily weaken scarcity/barter pressure rather than improve recurring mission preparation.
The rangefinder is durable reconnaissance equipment. Additional standing-gated copies do not create a meaningful recurring logistics privilege.

Field markers are consumed by mission preparation. Raising only their finite replenishment creates a visible logistics benefit from relationship standing without adding a new item source or bypassing a capability gate.

economyReview.authority: Economy Admiral ownership contract plus frozen Baseline economics
rationale: the relationship benefit changes finite replenishment capacity only; the 16,500 RUB unit price is invariant
the LL4 personal cap remains below half of total reset stock (10 of 24), preserving finite shared scarcity rather than converting the offer to effectively unlimited supply
the full LL1-to-LL4 personal privilege adds only six purchasable units and 99,000 RUB of spend capacity per reset
the uplift targets a consumed mission-preparation item rather than ammunition, access capability, durable equipment, raw barter material or an exceptional reward
Economy Admiral remains free to apply global pressure without reclassifying or mutating the immutable Baseline source offer
invalidatesApprovalIf: unit price is discounted by standing
LL4 stock exceeds 24 or personal buy restriction exceeds 10
the uplift is extended to another TPL without a separate economy review
projection mutates the global source assort rather than the request-scoped response

materializationArchitecture.reason: A root assort offer has one loyalty-level mapping and one stock/buy-restriction state; the four standing tiers in this specification must not be misread as four values that can coexist on one static offer.
projectionRules: start from the immutable Baseline marker offer rather than mutating the global trader database
select exactly one tier for the requesting profile
project only stockPerReset and buyRestriction from that tier
preserve offer id, tpl, price and quest/capability gates
fall back to frozen LL1 values when profile or standing cannot be resolved
never duplicate the root offer to encode standing tiers

publicationSeamProof.extensionMechanism: DynamicRouter at OnLoadOrder.Routers + 1 receives the previous matching router output and post-processes only the Admiral response

assortMutationContract.buyRestrictionCurrentOwner: SPT TraderAssortHelper persisted profile purchase projection
